title: Year 2047: Mineral Carbonization, Regreened Deserts & Climate Rebalance

beats.actTag: YEAR 2047 • HEALING TWO CENTURIES OF SKY HEAT
beats.narration:
By twenty forty-seven, humanity's annual industrial carbon emissions had fallen below zero, yet two centuries of bygone smokestacks still lingered as trapped thermal blankets in the sky—pressing upon mountain glaciers and arid subtropical belts.
Stopping new smoke was only half of stewardship; true responsibility meant restoring the sky we inherited.

beats.actTag: ACT I • PRAKRITI SAMYA: RETURNING SKY CARBON TO SOLID STONE

beats.narration:
Instead of risky atmospheric chemical sprays, engineers copied Earth's own oldest geological cycle—accelerated ten thousand times.
Modular direct-air mineralization towers drew excess carbon dioxide from the wind and reacted it with deep basaltic brines, locking it permanently into solid carbonate stone used to pave garden courtyards and coastal breakwaters.

beats.narration:
Simultaneously, remineralized ocean water piped inland fed thousand-kilometer syntropic green belts across the Sahara-Sahel margin, Central Asia, and inland Australia.
Newly rooted canopy corridors transpired cooling mist, reviving gentle seasonal rains, stabilizing Himalayan and Alpine snowpacks, and creating millions of fertile family homesteads.

beats.actTag: ACT III • THE 7D COMPASS: GENERATIONAL DUTY TO THE SKY
